title: nan
authors: Kong W.; Zhang D.; Wang X.; Xian Z.; Zhang J.
key_contribution: Presents autonomous UAV landing using a ground-based actuated infrared stereo vision system for tracking and localization in unknown GNSS-denied environments, validated in field experiments.
